translations.web: “Yet even now,” says Yahweh, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
translations.bsb: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
